If you cancel a court reservation two hours before the scheduled start time, it falls within the late cancellation window. According to Baseline Padel's Booking & Cancellation Policy, members may cancel free of charge only up to six hours before the start time. Cancellations made later than six hours before the session begins, including two hours before, are subject to late cancellation terms which may include charges or penalties. It is recommended to cancel as early as possible to avoid these.
